Name: Wallpaper for All Seasons - WFAS
Author: Khyraen
Description:
[size=2]Just in time for the holidays! 

[s]13[/s]  [s]18[/s]  [s]32[/s]  [s]40[/s] [/size][size=2] [/size][size=3][s]48[/s][/size][size=2]  [/size][size=5]52[/size][size=2] seasonal wallpapers. MORE summer content coming...[/size]

Ever had no idea how to decorate your house? Maybe you've felt your cabin needs more holiday spirit. Perhaps you are a minimalist & would love to slap on some wallpaper & have all your friends stop calling you Scrooge. This may be the mod you've been looking for!

We have created a collection of wallpapers that can be ADDED to your game based on SDV seasons & holidays. 

[s] Right now[/s] the collection [s]is[/s] [i][font=Comic Sans MS][size=1]was[/size][/font][/i] Fall heavy because [s]it's[/s] [i][font=Comic Sans MS]it was released in[/font][/i] October (& because F comes first in the alphabet), but there are several wallpapers for the other seasons that are [s]almost ready to be[/s] [i][font=Comic Sans MS]now[/font][/i] added. 

[size=5]Mod Requirements[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ (& it's requirements) and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12510]Custom Wallpaper Framework[/url]﻿.


[b][size=2]Mod Updates[/size][/b]

[b][size=2]0.1.1 Update | Oct 25, 2023[/size][/b]

* Added in 5 more wallpapers : 3 fall, 1 spring & 1 summer--because I had those coded in already and I wanted to...
* Added a Nexus update key

[b][size=2]0.1.2 Update | Oct 27, 2023[/size][/b]

* Fixed 2 wallpapers to add baseboards
* Added in 14 more wallpapers: 4 fall & 10 spring

[b][size=2]0.1.3 Update | Dec 20, 2023[/size][/b]

* Added in 8 more wallpapers: 2 spring, 1 summer & 5 winter
* MORE winter wallpapers should be done this week

[b][size=2]0.1.4 Update | Dec 21, 2023
[/size][/b]
* Added in 8 more winter wallpapers
* Improved on 5 wallpapers that were not up to our standard
* Fixed the width of a wallpaper in the coding to be correct 
* Still MORE winter wallpapers should be done this week

[b][size=2]0.1.5 Update | Dec 24, 2023
[/size][/b]
* Added in 4 more winter wallpapers
* Fixed the manifest error 
* No, really, I managed to do it this time


[b][size=3]Credits[/size][/b]

We were heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/142361808]StarAmy[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17900?tab=files]Double Wide Hallway Wallpapers[/url] & are thankful to her. Please check out her mods.

This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12510]Custom Wallpaper Framework[/url] to create wallpapers that are wider & therefore can have even more detailed & creative designs. That mod is required. We are thankful for this wonderful mod.

This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. We are grateful for this mod that enables so much of the SDV modding experience. 


[size=3][b]Our Other Mods[/b]

[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18918]Seasonal Hallway Wallpaper[/url] - Adds Custom Seasonal Wallpaper to your hallways using Custom Wallpaper Framework. Pairs well with this mod.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16815]Bathhouse Hot Spring w Solarium Compatibility[/url]﻿ - A patch that edits Bathhouse Hot Spring mod to be used with Solarium mod.


In the future, I will likely add a way to donate to my daughter, who is an amazing artist & who made the best of these wallpapers.
